en: Rocks! Cracked rocks! Nothing beats the feeling of smashing one to bits!
You look like you'd enjoy it too. Here, take this. It'll let your Pokémon smash rocks to rubble.
That's Rock Smash. Use it on a rock with cracks in it, and boom! Once you've got Mauville's Badge, that is.
Have you found a cracked rock yet? Smash it! Wild Pokémon sometimes hide in the rubble, too.
